text:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: In gymnosperms, the male and female gametophytes remain within the sporangia.
Statement II: In gymnosperms, seeds are not covered.
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given
below:
options: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
solution: Correct Answer: Option (B) - Both Statement I and Statement II are correct. In gymnosperms, male and female gametophytes do not have an independent free-living existence; they remain within the sporangia retained on sporophytes. Gymnosperms have naked seeds (not enclosed within an ovary wall/fruit).

text: Which one of the following is the characteristic feature of gymnosperms?

text:
Given below are the stages in the life cycle of pteridophytes. Arrange the following stages in the correct sequence.

A. Prothallus stage
B. Meiosis in spore mother cells
C. Fertilisation
D. Formation of archegonia and antheridia in gametophyte.
E. Transfer of antherozoids to the archegonia in presence of water.

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
solution: Correct Answer: Option (C) - B, A, D, E, C. Life cycle sequence in pteridophytes: Meiosis in spore mother cells (B) -> Haploid spores germinate into free-living prothallus gametophyte (A) -> Development of sex organs archegonia and antheridia (D) -> Transfer of biflagellate/multiflagellate antherozoids to archegonium in presence of water (E) -> Fertilisation forming diploid zygote (C).

text:
The correct sequence of events in the life cycle of bryophytes is
A. Fusion of antherozoid with egg.
B. Attachment of gametophyte to substratum.
C. Reduction division to produce haploid spores.
D. Formation of sporophyte.
E. Release of antherozoids into water.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
solution: Correct Answer: Option (A) - B, E, A, D, C. In bryophytes: Attachment of gametophyte to substratum (B) -> Release of flagellated antherozoids into water (E) -> Fusion of antherozoid with egg in archegonium (A) -> Formation of sporophyte (D) -> Reduction division in capsule to produce haploid spores (C).

text:
Read the following statements and choose the set of correct statements:
In the members of Phaeophyceae,
A. Asexual reproduction occurs usually by biflagellate zoospores.
B. Sexual reproduction is by oogamous method only.
C. Stored food is in the form of carbohydrates which is either mannitol or laminarin.
D. The major pigments found are chlorophyll a, c and carotenoids and xanthophyll.
E. Vegetative cells have a cellulosic wall, usually covered on the outside by gelatinous coating of
algin.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options: A, B, C and D only
B, C, D and E only
A, C, D and E only
A, B, C and E only
solution: Correct Answer: Option (C) - A, C, D and E only. In Phaeophyceae (brown algae): zoospores are biflagellate (pyriform with two unequal lateral flagella), food stored as mannitol/laminarin, major pigments are chlorophyll a, c, carotenoids, fucoxanthin, and cell wall has cellulose and algin. Sexual reproduction can be isogamous, anisogamous, or oogamous (not oogamous only). Hence statements A, C, D, and E are correct.
